prompt: I have an existing VS Code extension scaffolded with yo code. I need to add a webview panel that shows a live-updating chart of system memory usage. The webview should communicate with the extension host to get data every 2 seconds. How do I set this up with proper CSP, theming, and state persistence?

assertions.name: has-csp
assertions.description: HTML includes Content-Security-Policy meta tag with webview.cspSource

assertions.name: has-message-passing
assertions.description: Bidirectional postMessage/onDidReceiveMessage between extension and webview

assertions.name: has-theming
assertions.description: Uses VS Code CSS variables (--vscode-*) for theme adaptation

assertions.name: has-state-persistence
assertions.description: Uses getState/setState or WebviewPanelSerializer for state persistence

assertions.name: has-nonce
assertions.description: Generates nonce for script tags in CSP
